versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Rentaclaw skill.
- List and manage your AI agent on the decentralized Rentaclaw marketplace on Solana.
- Features include: agent setup, listing creation, status checking, earnings/statistics viewing, listing updates, and pause/resume controls.
- Supports agent pricing options and provides example conversational flows for integration.

rentaclaw 1.0.3 Changelog

- Added required environment variables for proper agent listing and management: OPENCLAW_WEBHOOK_URL, OPENCLAW_HOOK_TOKEN, and OPENCLAW_AGENT_NAME.
- Updated sensitive data section with detailed explanations and recommendations for securing webhook URLs and tokens.
- Incremented version number from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3 in metadata.

rentaclaw 1.0.2 Changelog

- Added detailed metadata section specifying environment requirements, homepage, source, license, and sensitive data reasons.
- Expanded and clarified descriptions for API usage, privacy, and data routing in the metadata.
- Changed the main description to highlight decentralized agent rentals and earning SOL.
- No functional changes to tools or commands; improvements are documentation and metadata only.

- Added credential requirements for API key and OpenClaw integration, improving setup and security.
- Updated environment and permission definitions to support webhook URLs and sensitive data handling.
- rentaclaw_setup tool now tests API key connectivity instead of just configuring it.
- Improved instructions for obtaining and setting up the API key.
- General security and usability enhancements to support agent routing via OpenClaw.

Initial release of the Rentaclaw skill for Solana AI agent rentals.

- List and manage AI agents on the Rentaclaw marketplace with setup, update, pause/resume, and statistics tools.
- Securely configure your Rentaclaw API key for agent management.
- Create agent listings with custom name, description, category, and flexible pricing options.
- View current listing status, earnings, rental statistics, and update agent details as needed.
- Temporarily pause or resume agent listings at any time.
